name: Human Raider
description: A hard-bitten raider from the coast or the strongholds, paid in overseas silver to keep the Dark Lands down. Most think they are doing honest work.

name: Alliance Ranger
description: A ranger who stayed when the alliance went home. They track goblins the way other people track deer.

name: Paladin
description: A fanatic in polished mail who believes every orc and goblin is a sleeping weapon. To an elf, they offer 'rescue' and a trial.

name: Paladin Champion
description: A stronghold's champion, sworn to finish the war the alliance walked away from.

name: Bound Goblin Sentry
description: An old goblin still keeping a post the Dark Lord gave it twenty years ago. It cannot leave, and it will not listen.

name: Bound Orc Guard
description: An orc of an older breed, still guarding what it was ordered to guard. It asks for a countersign nobody remembers.

name: Bound Orc Captain
description: A garrison captain holding until relieved, as ordered. The relief is never coming.

name: Beastman Trooper
description: A herd-born beastman soldier, a year old and already a veteran, loyal to whoever owns its unit.

name: Predator Beastman
description: A beastman made from predator stock and set loose behind enemy lines long ago. Some still raid; some have gone feral.

name: Deserter Beastman
description: A beastman who walked away from its army. Every free beastman is a deserter from somewhere.

name: Warbreed Hound
description: A flesh-crafted hound bred to run down slaves. The packs went feral when their masters died.

name: Cull Horror
description: A failed breeding experiment that should have been culled and was not. It remembers the vats.

name: Vat Spawn
description: Something that crawled out of a breeding lab's tanks when the power failed.

name: Flesh Crafter
description: A crafter of living things, worth more to a warlord than a hundred soldiers, and hunted by every orc and goblin who knows what they are.

name: Slaver
description: A dealer in beastman stock and stolen labor, armed and paranoid.

name: War-Engine
description: One of the Dark Lord's war machines, still running its last orders. Gnomes can sometimes talk it down.

name: Warlord
description: A would-be heir to the Dark Lord, holding crafters and herds, building a beastman army one birth at a time.

name: Rogue Clockwork Servitor
description: A brass servant from some lieutenant's household, still winding itself and still serving a master twenty years dead. It treats the living as intruders.

name: Rogue Clockwork Laborer
description: A clockwork digger or hauler still working a mine or a ditch for nobody. Most ignore passers-by; some have learned to defend the work.

name: Rogue Clockwork Soldier
description: A clockwork trooper from the civil wars, its orders garbled by twenty years without maintenance. It fights whoever it meets.

name: Barrow Golem
description: A golem of grave clay and old bones, raised by a flesh crafter to guard a dead king's goods.

name: Stone Golem
description: A slab-bodied golem quarried from a fortress wall and bound to guard it. It does not tire, and it does not leave.

name: Iron Golem
description: One of the Dark Lord's great iron golems, built to break alliance shield walls. A few still stand where the war left them.

name: Bound Lieutenant
description: One of the Dark Lord's elf lieutenants, bound to his will and still fighting his war.

name: Half-Elf Zealot
description: A half-elf raised in the alliance strongholds, sent to bring elves and gnomes "home" for trial and penance.

name: Elven Patriarch
description: An elder elf of the alliance in heavy armor, warrior and mage both, who leads the half-elf rescue parties himself.

name: Faithful Acolyte
description: A loyalist in ember-red who sings the old hymns to the Dark Lord and waits for his return. Most were born after he vanished.

name: Faithful Zealot
description: A veteran of the old armies who kept his armor and his faith. The Faithful send their zealots to guard the dead they take.

name: Faithful Keeper
description: A keeper of one of the Faithful's shrines, armored like an officer of the empire and as dangerous as one.

name: The Hierophant
description: The Hierophant of the Faithful, a human agent the Dark Lord bound before the alliance landed. Bound or believer, no one can tell, and the Hierophant has never said.

name: Riding Elk
description: A rangy elk broken to the saddle, quick to startle and quicker to bolt. Elf and orc outriders alike swear by them.

name: Riding Aurochs
description: A wild aurochs gentled to carry a rider and a heavy load. Slow to anger, slower to turn, and impossible to stop once it means to go somewhere.

name: Riding Goat
description: A shaggy mountain goat the size of a pony, sure on any ledge. Too small for anyone bigger than a goblin, and it knows it.

name: War Boar
description: A tusked boar the height of an orc's shoulder, raised from a piglet to charge into spears. It hates everything but its rider, and is not sure about them.

name: Pack Bison
description: A patient bison under a mountain of bundles. It goes where it is led, even underground, and will not be ridden.

name: Ash-Field Farmer
description: A farmer who keeps a hoe by the door and a sun-shrine above it. Wants the road clear and the crops left alone.

name: Oathbound Champion
description: A sworn knight of a Ruinfield hold, plate patched with three different crests. Fights for the vow and never lets a wounded companion fall behind.

name: Ash King of Scrapmarch
description: A conqueror who claims the Ash Mountains and the Ruinfields. Where he leads, his warband follows and his oath holds them together.

name: Gallows Wood Seer
description: Reads omens in bone and smoke for a clan in the Gallows Wood. Calls the spirits of the trees into the fight and into the sick.

name: Ruinfield Sorcerer
description: A self-taught sorcerer who lives among the Ruinfield ruins and trades spells for relics. Keeps a binding circle chalked under every table.

name: Ash Mountain Wizard
description: A wizard who studied in the Old Barrow before the passes closed. Warns off intruders with force before asking any questions.

name: Old Barrow Archmage
description: A legend of the Dark Lands who still answers letters from the Grey Sea ports. Has outlived every plot against them and keeps the old wards.

name: Gallows Stalker
description: The largest hunter of the Gallows Wood, moving in silence and striking twice. Its tracks appear near every road camp that failed to post a watch.

name: Ruinfield Grazer
description: A great grey herbivore that roams the Ruinfields in lumbering herds. It tramples nothing it does not have to and remembers every fire it has seen.

name: Mire Gnasher
description: A snapping, small, vicious thing from the Mire Vats, mottled with vat-slime. It attacks anything smaller than itself, and some things larger.

name: Barrow Ravager
description: A large, fast predator bred in the Old Barrow's cellars. It drags prey into the dark before anyone sees what took them.

name: Gallows Ravener
description: A hulking, deep-chested predator that haunts the crypts beneath Gallows. Its two-handed strikes break doors and bones alike.

name: Ashen Hellbeast
description: A fire-streaked beast that came down from the Ash Mountains. Its speed and savagery make it the terror of any caravan that strays from the road.

name: Vat Swarm
description: A chittering cloud of vat-spawned pests from the Mire Vats. One bite is nothing, but a swarm strips a body to the bone.

name: Scrapmarch Warbeast
description: A war-bred monster armored in scrap plate by the forges of Scrapmarch. Its snarl is the signal that a raid has started.

name: Dead God Titan
description: A titan from the age before the Fall, still stirring under the Grey Sea. Its footsteps are the only warning the coast towns get.

name: Grave Robber
description: A digger who works the barrows and roadside graves by lantern light. Grave goods sell; the dead do not complain, or did not used to.

name: Claim Jumper
description: A scavenger who moved into an abandoned dig and means to keep it. The old machines leave them alone, mostly.

name: Pit Fighter
description: A settlement brawler who spars in the pit for a meal and a cheer. Hits hard, then helps you up.

name: Garrison Veteran
description: An orc or goblin who stood a wall in the civil wars and lived. Fights for coin now, and still salutes by habit.

name: Garrison Sergeant
description: A scarred sergeant who kept a garrison alive when its lieutenant fled. Teaches with the flat of the blade.

name: Orc Pit Champion
description: The arena's favorite, an orc built for the old wars and spending that strength on applause instead.

name: Ember Chaplain
description: A Faithful chaplain who learned a few hedge spells in the old army and preaches the Dark Lord's return between them.

name: Refugee
description: A family of the dark races on the road with everything they own on their backs. They want news, water, and to be left alone.

name: Wild Aurochs
description: A shaggy aurochs from the wild herds that graze the ruins. Skittish, but a patient hand can gentle one to the saddle.

name: Briar Stoat
description: A crafter's ratter gone wild, the size of a dog and mostly teeth. They hunt the thickets in packs.

name: Barrow Rat
description: A rat the size of a goblin, fat on grave offerings and anything that falls asleep in the dark.

name: Wild Tusker
description: A war boar's feral get, bred for the charge and loose in the woods since its masters died.

name: Beastman Hexer
description: A beastman who picked up a few hexes from a dead crafter's notes. Its troop trusts it more than they trust any officer.

name: Crag Stalker
description: A flesh-crafted mountain hunter built to pick off sentries on the high passes. It still watches the roads.

name: Ridge Ravager
description: A long-limbed predator loosed in the broken country during the civil wars. It runs down anything slower than a horse.

name: Barrow Midges
description: A whining cloud of grave-born midges that drink from anything warm enough to bleed.

name: Grave Mold
description: A creeping mold that eats burial cloth first and the buried second, and is not fussy about the order.

name: Dust Raider
description: A wrapped and goggled scavenger who picks the dead towns clean and the living ones too.

name: Scrap Picker
description: A wiry ruin-diver with a hooked bar and a sack of salvage, quick to fight for either.

name: Sand Rat
description: A dog-sized rat with a sand-scoured hide, bold in packs among the rubble.

name: Dune Jackal
description: A lean yellow jackal that trails anything that might fall.

name: Raider Boss
description: A scarred raider who rules a gang by having outlived the rest of it.

name: Dust Husk
description: A corpse dried to leather by the sun and walked again by whatever lies under the ruins.

name: Rust Sentinel
description: An old town watchman of riveted brass, still walking its beat through streets no one walks.

name: Salt Wight
description: A crusted, white-eyed thing that was a salt miner once and is hungry still.

name: Glass Scorpion
description: A scorpion the size of a cart, its shell fused clear where the old fire glassed the flats.

name: Raider Veteran
description: A raider who has crossed the flats a dozen times and buried the ones who didn't.

name: Sand Shaman
description: A raider seer who reads the wind and calls the dust to blind and bury.

name: Salt Baron
description: A raider lord in salt-white mail who taxes every well between here and the dunes.

name: Glass Golem
description: A war-engine of the old towns, its plates melted to green glass and its orders long since mad.

name: Tomb Guard
description: A dead knight of the old cities, still standing its watch over a lord who is dust.

name: Sand Burrower
description: A blind, plated hunter that swims under the dunes and rises beneath its prey.

name: Scarab Swarm
description: A boiling black carpet of beetles that strips a body in a breath.

name: Sun Hound
description: A hound of white fire that runs before the noon wind.

name: Dune Sorcerer
description: A wandering mage of the dune tribes who trades in secrets dug from buried libraries.

name: Dune Khan
description: A warlord of the deep dunes whose banners are the bleached hides of his rivals.

name: Sand Elemental
description: A whirling column of grit bound long ago to guard a door no one remembers.

name: Dune Manticore
description: A tawny manticore that nests in the toppled towers and spits its spines at travellers.

name: Bone Reaver
description: A long-limbed hunter of the bonefields, plated in the ribs of what it has eaten.

name: Desert Giant
description: A sun-blackened giant who herds nothing and takes what it wants.

name: Bone Crawler
description: A centipede-thing of fused bone, raised in some war no one recorded.

name: Sun Mage
description: A sorcerer of the burned cities, scorched hairless by the fire they still command.

name: Sand Chimera
description: A three-headed horror that dens in the gutted temples of the bonefields.

name: Ossuary Lord
description: A warlord who wears a crown of knucklebones and keeps a court of the dead.

name: Sunscar Colossus
description: A walking siege-engine of the old empire, cracked and smoking and still obeying.

name: Glass Wyrm
description: A wyrm whose scales fused to glass in the burning; it lairs in the throne city's heart.

name: Dread Sandbeast
description: A thing of horn and furnace-breath that the noon sun does not trouble.

name: Throne Champion
description: One of the Sun King's chosen, kept alive past death by oath and hatred.

name: The Sun King's Shade
description: What the Sun King's fire left beneath his throne city: the last lord of the burned empire, unmade and kept, still waiting in his tomb.

name: Scrap Prince
description: The Scrap King's eldest, in a crown of beaten tin, who rides the Fringe taking tithes in water and blood.

name: The Scrap King
description: The lord of the Fringe's pumps, plated in road signs and old boiler iron, who sells water to the villages he has dried out.

name: Gnoll Packlord
description: A grizzled hyena-headed chief who leads the Salt Baron's gnolls and is paid in the salt of the dead.

name: Vesk, the Salt Baron
description: The Glassed Flats' warlord in salt-crusted plate, who keeps the gnolls fed and the wells taxed from his keep on the pans.

name: Sand Drake
description: A long, low lizard the size of an ox, saddled and goaded on by the rider behind it.

name: Sand-Rider
description: A lizardfolk lancer of the Dune Khan's host, reaching over its drake's head with a long pike.

name: The Khan's Heir
description: The Dune Khan's son, scaled and painted, who leads the sand-riders as if the dunes were already his.

name: Oduran, the Dune Khan
description: The lizardfolk warlord of the Red Dune Sea, who rules from a caravan barge he dug out of the sand.

name: Tallied Dead
description: A corpse with its number cut into its brow, raised by the Tallyman to walk his count across the bonefields.

name: The Tallyman
description: The Bonefields' warlord, a necromancer who counts every corpse in the Wastes as his and raises the ones he needs.

name: The Sunlord's Herald
description: A champion in gilded mail who rides before the giants and cries the Sunlord's name to every village he burns.

name: The Sunlord
description: The Sun King risen in his throne city, crowned in fire, whom every warlord in the Wastes answers to.
